A '''Dug rail gun''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] piece that served in [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare's]] armed forces during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The Dug [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]] was equipped with treads for movement and its launching system could be positioned at different angles to fire both upwards and downwards, depending on the target's position. A [[Dug debris loader/Legends|Dug debris loader]] would place an explosive charge on the weapon's launch rail, which would hurl it towards its target. An enclosed cockpit was located at the front of the vehicle for the driver/gunner.

==History==
They were used at the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], where they bombarded the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], notably as anti-air cover for [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] against [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] as they moved to the drop point for the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|Electro-proton bomb]], which neutralized the opposing force. In the aftermath, the rail guns were again used in an attempt to kill the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo beast]] which was awakened by the detonation of the bomb during the battle. Unfortunately, every single rail gun was destroyed.
